body.x: Withings Reveals range of colorful analog watches with built-in activity trackers and fashion forward designWithings(www.withings.com), a company with a mission to lead the connected-health revolution, revealed an activity tracker "Activité Pop" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Activité Pop has the look of an analog watch, but can track activities like the latest wearable devices. It features a lightweight and fun-to-wear design that extends across the PVD-coated watchcase and the smooth silicone strap. The watch comes in three colors (Azure, Shark Grey, Sand) and a set of soon-to-come playful wristbands. There is no hassle of recharging it since the battery lasts up to 8 months with a single charge. Also, it is water resistant up to 30 meters."We've paired Activité's elegant Parisian design with fun-to-wear materials and pop colors in order to create a very personal device that people would want to wear and never take off," said Cédric Hutchings, CEO of Withings.Activité Pop features two hand dials, one for the time and the other for tracking activities. The users can set the objective of the day, and can easily check the progress throughout the day. The watch vibrates when the goal is achieved. The watch also can differentiate the sport activities and tracks them accordingly. When worn at night, it monitors sleep quality and wakes the user up with a gentle vibration.As with all Withings devices, Activité Pop syncs automatically with the free Withings Health Mate application, named one of Apple's Best Apps of 2014. Health Mate acts as a coach to help useres achieve personal goals.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
